topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out that my best friend is moving across the country. It feels like everything is changing too fast, all of a sudden. I can’t help but think about all the memories we’ve built together, from late-night talks to spontaneous adventures. Now, the idea of those moments becoming just memories is a bit overwhelming. I know we promised to stay in touch, to make it work no matter the distance, but nothing will be the same. I guess I’ll have to find a new rhythm, a new way to handle the quiet times that used to be filled with laughter and plans. It’s a big step for both of us, and I want to be supportive, even if it means saying goodbye to the way things are.
